E0220

A place is read through its owner while an exclusive write window into it is still live.

What

A place is read through its owner while an exclusive write window into it is still live.

Why

An exclusive window (a pin or a mutable view) already gives write access to that storage; reading the owner beside it would be rejected after lowering.

Fix

Read or edit through the live window name instead of the owner.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0220: tests/ui/ownership/named_write_window_calls_keep_alias_and_read_view_checks.stderr.

Error [E0111]: `window` was made with `::`, so it can't be changed
  --> named_write_window_calls_keep_alias_and_read_view_checks.jet:9:11
    |
  9 |     both(&window, value)
    |           ^^^^^^
 Why: `both` will change this value, so it must be mutable (`:=`)
 Fix: Declare it with `window := ...`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0111

Error [E0204]: `value` is being changed in this call, so it can't be used again here
  --> named_write_window_calls_keep_alias_and_read_view_checks.jet:9:19
    |
  9 |     both(&window, value)
    |                   ^^^^^
 Why: While something is being changed through the write-access marker `&`, nobody else may be looking at it
 Fix: Pass the write-access marker `&` (`&value`) only once, or copy first with `value.copy()`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0204

Error [E0220]: `value` cannot be read while `window` has a live exclusive write window into it
  --> named_write_window_calls_keep_alias_and_read_view_checks.jet:9:19
    |
  9 |     both(&window, value)
    |                   ^^^^^
 Why: `window` is an exclusive window into `value`; reading the owner beside that window would be rejected after lowering
 Fix: Read or edit through `window` instead of `value`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0220
